top_choice_rationale: P001 awards the single GLP-1 prize part to Holst, Drucker and Mojsov. It covers a complete discovery arc: gut incretin physiology and GLP-1 secretion, proglucagon-derived peptide biology, and identification and synthesis of the active truncated peptide. Decades of independent confirmation and large randomized outcome trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity show maturity and transformative impact. The three-laureate allocation and the citation scope, which is tied to physiology and active peptide forms rather than to drug development, are defensible. No award is clearly inferior to a mature, well-attributed achievement.
